descriptions: Compare a locally supplied PHP version. No external scan or account required.
Use dated advice and official links. A version result is not a security certificate.
Vendor backports need the exact package revision. Learn what to ask your host.
Free update and incident checklists. Agree scope before requesting any assistance.
approval_notes: Review current official platform policies and technical-support eligibility before any paid launch. Character-limit validation does not establish policy compliance. No spend or campaign activation is approved.
